title: Genie One and Genie Agents can now use models served through OpenAI on Databricks
body: [Genie One](/aws/en/genie-one) and [Genie Agents](/aws/en/genie-agents) can now use models served through OpenAI on Databricks when [partner-powered AI features](/aws/en/databricks-ai/partner-powered) are enabled. For the hosting provider used by each feature, see [Hosting provider used when partner-powered AI features setting is enabled and disabled](/aws/en/databricks-ai/partner-powered#features).
